{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the cleaned data
df_clean = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, removing commas
df_clean['revenue'] = df_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders
df_clean = df_clean[df_clean['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Confirm we have 894 rows
assert len(df_clean) == 894, f"Expected 894 rows, got {len(df_clean)}"

# Check the distribution of customer_segment by channel
crosstab = pd.crosstab(df_clean['channel'], df_clean['customer_segment'])
print("Cross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:")
print(crosstab)

# Compute conversion rates within each segment
# We will compute conversion rate for each (channel, segment) group
conversion_rates = df_clean.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().reset_index()
print("\nConversion rates by channel and segment:")
print(conversion_rates)

# Compute the difference in conversion rates within each segment (email - paid_search)
diff_by_segment = conversion_rates[conversion_rates['channel'] == 'email'].set_index('customer_segment')['converted'] - \
                 conversion_rates[conversion_rates['channel'] == 'paid_search'].set_index('customer_segment')['converted']
print("\nDifference in conversion rates (email - paid_search) by segment:")
print(diff_by_segment)

# Compute the weighted average of the differences, weighted by segment size in the overall population
# Total number of orders in each segment
segment_sizes = df_clean['customer_segment'].value_counts()
print("\nSegment sizes:")
print(segment_sizes)

# Weight for each segment: size in segment / total size
weights = segment_sizes / segment_sizes.sum()
print("\nSegment weights:")
print(weights)

# Weighted average of differences
weighted_diff = (diff_by_segment * weights).sum()
print(f"\nWeighted average difference (email - paid_search): {weighted_diff}")

# Convert to percentage points
weighted_diff_percent = weighted_diff * 100
print(f"\nWeighted average difference in percentage points: {weighted_diff_percent}")"}
